messages:
maria: quick sync  we need a tiny onboarding probe policy when bench budget is constrained. goal: catch common runtime regressions cheaply.

sam: totally. proposal: FAST smoke everywhere: latency_p95, kv-cache sanity, tokenizer diff. deterministic, short seq.

jon: add 20 golden prompts in FAST to catch decode/serialization issues. low cost, high signal.

maria: plan: tiers FAST (<=45s, every submit), MID (5-12m on tokenizer/arch/major config changes or sampled), DEEP (>30m nightly/manual).

eva: FAST should capture cold-start (first N tokens) too. often where regressions hide.

sam: if FAST fails -> promote to MID and block onboarding until triage. surface artifacts in Console.

probe-bot: probe-bot: FAST last run: latency_p95=42ms, coldstart_p95=85ms, kv_miss=0.02, tokenizer_diff=0, golden_mismatches=0. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. i'll draft a short RFC formalizing tiers, intake selection rules, metric schema, and the FAST-failure runbook. tagging @sam @jon @eva for review.
